# Noto Sans Arabic

- **Version:** 2.013, static Regular (hinted TTF).
- **Source:** the `notofonts/arabic` release `NotoSansArabic-v2.013`, `NotoSansArabic/hinted/ttf/NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-10-16. The project is <https://github.com/notofonts/arabic>.
- **Copyright:** 2022 The Noto Project Authors.
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt`. Allowed for fonts by ADR 0036.
- **Coverage:** the Arabic script (Arabic, Persian, Urdu and others), Arabic-Indic digits.
- **Use:** right-to-left text in `engine_text`'s tests and golden images (`engine_text::fonts::NOTO_SANS_ARABIC`); a game may use it in its font stack for Arabic (ADR 0102).
- **Changes:** none (unmodified).
